form.label: Enterprise STIG Compliance Dashboard
form.description: Executive STIG Compliance Monitoring for Enterprise Assets (Powered by results from NIWC Atlantic's SCAP Compliance Checker)

search.query: `scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" | eval profile_id=if(isnull(profile_id) OR profile_id=="", "Unknown", profile_id), target_os=if(isnull(target_os) OR target_os=="", "Unknown", target_os), target_os_version=if(isnull(target_os_version) OR target_os_version=="", "Unknown", target_os_version), target_os_family=if(isnull(target_os_family) OR target_os_family=="", "Unknown", target_os_family), primary_ip=coalesce(primary_ip, ip, "N/A"), host_id=coalesce(host_id, smbios_uuid, host, "N/A"), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A"), benchmark_id=if(isnull(benchmark_id) OR benchmark_id=="", "Unknown", benchmark_id), rules_informational=coalesce(rules_informational, rules_info, cat4_fails, 0) | search (profile_id="$mac_tok$" OR "$mac_tok$"="*") (target_os="$os_tok$" OR "$os_tok$"="*") (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") | stats latest(_time) as max_time, latest(benchmark_score) as score_clean, latest(rules_passed) as rules_passed, latest(rules_failed) as rules_failed, latest(rules_error) as rules_error, latest(rules_not_checked) as rules_not_checked, latest(rules_informational) as rules_informational, latest(cat1_fails) as cat1_fails, latest(cat2_fails) as cat2_fails, latest(cat3_fails) as cat3_fails, latest(cat4_fails) as cat4_fails, latest(primary_ip) as primary_ip, latest(target_os) as target_os, latest(target_os_version) as target_os_version, latest(target_os_family) as target_os_family, latest(host_id) as host_id, latest(scan_id) as scan_id, latest(profile_id) as profile_id by host, benchmark_id
`scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" earliest=-30d@d | stats count by profile_id | fields profile_id
`scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" earliest=-30d@d | stats count by target_os | fields target_os
`scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" earliest=-30d@d | stats count by benchmark_id | sort benchmark_id | fields benchmark_id
| stats avg(score_clean) as mean_score | eval mean_score=round(mean_score, 1) | fields mean_score
| stats dc(eval(if(host_id=="N/A", host, host_id))) as total_hosts | fields total_hosts
| stats dc(eval(if(cat1_fails > 0, coalesce(nullif(host_id,"N/A"), host), null()))) as high_risk_hosts | fields high_risk_hosts

`scap_index` event_type="rule_result" | eval clean_res=lower(result), clean_sev=lower(severity), benchmark_id=coalesce(benchmark_id, ruleset, "Unknown") | search (clean_res="fail" OR clean_res="error") (clean_sev="cat1" OR clean_sev="cat i" OR clean_sev="high") (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") | stats dc(rule_id) as unique_cat1_rules | fields unique_cat1_rules
| stats sum(cat1_fails) as total_cat1 | fields total_cat1

| stats avg(score_clean) as host_score by host, host_id | eval Tier=case( host_score >= 90, "Compliant", host_score >= 80 AND host_score < 90, "At Risk", host_score < 80, "Non-Compliant" ) | stats count by Tier

| stats sum(cat1_fails) as "CAT I (High)", sum(cat2_fails) as "CAT II (Medium)", sum(cat3_fails) as "CAT III (Low)", sum(rules_informational) as "CAT IV (Info)" | eval metric="Severity" | fields metric, "CAT I (High)", "CAT II (Medium)", "CAT III (Low)", "CAT IV (Info)"

`scap_index` event_type="rule_result" cci_id="*" | eval benchmark_id=coalesce(benchmark_id, ruleset, "Unknown"), host_id=coalesce(host_id, smbios_uuid, host, "N/A"), scan_id=coalesce(scan_id, "N/A") | search (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") | streamstats max(_time) as latest_scan_time by host_id, benchmark_id | where _time == latest_scan_time | eval clean_res=lower(result) | search (clean_res="fail" OR clean_res="error") | stats count as fail_count, dc(host_id) as affected_hosts by cci_id | sort - fail_count | head 10 | rename cci_id as "Control Identifier (CCI)", fail_count as "Failure Count"

chart.title: Compliance Posture Velocity (Daily Avg vs. 7-Day Moving Avg)

search.query: `scap_index` event_type="scan_summary" | eval profile_id=if(isnull(profile_id) OR profile_id=="", "Unknown", profile_id), target_os=if(isnull(target_os) OR target_os=="", "Unknown", target_os), benchmark_id=if(isnull(benchmark_id) OR benchmark_id=="", "Unknown", benchmark_id) | search (profile_id="$mac_tok$" OR "$mac_tok$"="*") (target_os="$os_tok$" OR "$os_tok$"="*") (benchmark_id="$bench_tok$" OR "$bench_tok$"="*") | bin _time span=1d | stats latest(benchmark_score) as daily_score by _time, host, benchmark_id | timechart span=1d avg(daily_score) as raw_avg | trendline sma7(raw_avg) as sma_temp | eval "Daily Avg Compliance (%)"=if(isnotnull(raw_avg) AND raw_avg > 0, round(raw_avg, 1), null()) | eval "7-Day Moving Avg (%)"=if(isnotnull(sma_temp) AND sma_temp > 0, round(sma_temp, 1), null()) | fields _time, "Daily Avg Compliance (%)", "7-Day Moving Avg (%)"

| stats latest(target_os) as os_name, latest(target_os_version) as os_version, avg(score_clean) as mean_score, sum(cat1_fails) as cat1 by host, host_id | stats count as host_count, sum(cat1) as total_cat1, avg(mean_score) as avg_score by os_name, os_version | eval "Mean Score (%)"=round(avg_score, 1) | fields os_name, os_version, host_count, total_cat1, "Mean Score (%)" | sort - total_cat1, - host_count | rename os_name as "OS Name", os_version as "OS Version", host_count as "Host Count", total_cat1 as "Total CAT I Fails"

| stats avg(score_clean) as avg_score, dc(eval(if(host_id=="N/A", host, host_id))) as "Hosts Evaluated", sum(cat1_fails) as "CAT I Fails", sum(cat2_fails) as "CAT II Fails", sum(cat3_fails) as "CAT III Fails", sum(rules_informational) as "CAT IV Fails" by benchmark_id | eval "Avg Score (%)"=round(avg_score, 1) | fields benchmark_id, "Hosts Evaluated", "Avg Score (%)", "CAT I Fails", "CAT II Fails", "CAT III Fails", "CAT IV Fails" | sort - "CAT I Fails", "Avg Score (%)" | rename benchmark_id as "STIG Benchmark"

| eval target_bench=trim(coalesce("$selected_benchmark$", "*")) | where benchmark_id==target_bench OR target_bench=="*" | eval scan_date=strftime(max_time, "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M") | fields host, primary_ip, target_os, target_os_version, score_clean, cat1_fails, cat2_fails, cat3_fails, rules_informational, scan_date | sort score_clean | rename host as "Host", primary_ip as "IP Address", target_os as "OS", target_os_version as "OS Version", score_clean as "Score (%)", cat1_fails as "CAT I Fails", cat2_fails as "CAT II Fails", cat3_fails as "CAT III Fails", rules_informational as "CAT IV Fails", scan_date as "Evaluated"

| eval target_os_filter=trim(coalesce("$selected_os$", "*")) | where target_os==target_os_filter OR target_os_filter=="*" | stats avg(score_clean) as avg_score, sum(cat1_fails) as cat1, sum(cat2_fails) as cat2, sum(cat3_fails) as cat3, sum(rules_informational) as cat4, latest(primary_ip) as primary_ip, latest(target_os_version) as target_os_version, latest(max_time) as last_eval by host, host_id | eval "Mean Score (%)"=round(avg_score, 1), scan_date=strftime(last_eval, "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M") | fields host, primary_ip, target_os_version, "Mean Score (%)", cat1, cat2, cat3, cat4, scan_date | sort "Mean Score (%)", - cat1 | rename host as "Host", primary_ip as "IP Address", target_os_version as "OS Version", cat1 as "CAT I Fails", cat2 as "CAT II Fails", cat3_fails as "CAT III Fails", cat4 as "CAT IV Fails", scan_date as "Last Evaluated"
